info.title: Dobby Rental Car Booking API
info.description: Design contract for a backend-only pair project. Not a deployed or implemented API. All date-only rules use Asia/Bangkok; monetary values are integer satang. Unknown input/query fields are rejected. API contract is authoritative; examples are synthetic. See docs/api-contract.md for error precedence and docs/service-contracts.md for atomic behavior.

post.description: Server assigns user role. Telephone required. Reject role/provider/status fields. Creates account and initial session.

post.summary: Register a representative and initial company application
post.description: Atomically create company-role account, stable provider and version 1 pending application. Login email and profile.contactEmail are distinct fields. No booking capability.
Issue 24-hour JWT and persisted session. Suspended representative gets 403 PROVIDER_SUSPENDED; pending/rejected representatives may log in.
Verify presented JWT/session, then revoke it. Allow suspended representatives to logout; no protected company data is returned. Reuse of this token then returns 401.

get.description: No password/hash/session internals. Suspended representatives denied with 403; pending/rejected can inspect their account.
Only approved companies with a last-approved profile. Never expose pending profile/document URLs, account data or booking history. Ordered createdAt descending then id descending.

get.summary: Find active vehicles of approved companies
get.description: Filter window/overlap when both dates supplied. Without dates, show active listings with non-expired windows. Never populate private bookings. Count and page use same predicate. Availability is advisory until atomic booking creation.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Literal case-insensitive substring, escaped; not client regex.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Supply with dueDate; filter available vehicles for the entire interval.

schema.description: Validated inclusive calendar date, Asia/Bangkok; no time component.
Validated inclusive calendar date, Asia/Bangkok; no time component.

get.description: Only active vehicle of approved company with non-expired window; otherwise 404. Availability is not a reservation.
Pending/rejected/approved representatives only; suspended denied. Latest approved data remains in effect while revision is pending/rejected.
Pending/rejected/approved only, never suspended. Ordered version descending.

post.summary: Submit a new immutable profile version
post.description: At most one pending application. Stable registration number copied by server. Retain current approved profile and provider eligibility during review; resubmission after rejection creates next version. Suspended denied.

get.summary: List own active and inactive vehicles
get.description: Approved representative only. Scope by trusted provider ID; never accept arbitrary owner scope.

post.description: Approved only. Provider assigned server-side, isActive defaults true, availableUntil defaults null. Reject duplicate normalized VIN even if existing vehicle inactive.

get.description: Approved only; inactive vehicles visible to owner. Cross-company IDs return 404.

patch.summary: Change pickup branch and/or daily rate
patch.description: Approved owner only. All other descriptive fields fixed, even before first booking. Old bookings keep original pickup branch and rate snapshots.
Approved owner only. Inclusive from/until; null end = open ended. Reject changes excluding any existing upcoming/ongoing confirmed booking. Never implicitly cancel bookings.
Approved owner only. Idempotent state assignment. Inactive blocks new bookings, preserves existing ones. Reactivation does not create/restore bookings.

get.summary: List own bookings or all bookings as admin
get.description: Customers scoped to self; userId/providerId filters rejected for customers. Admin may filter globally. All effective statuses available. No arbitrary projection/populate.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Effective booking status, computed from Asia/Bangkok today.

post.description: Customer only; admin/company cannot book. Server derives owner/provider/rate/snapshot/total. startDate >= Thailand today, 1–30 inclusive days, entire interval inside window, approved provider and active vehicle. At most 3 confirmed bookings with dueDate >= today. Reject same-vehicle inclusive overlap atomically.

get.summary: Read own booking or any as admin
get.description: Customer must own record; otherwise 404. Approved-company reads use dedicated company routes.

patch.description: Only confirmed booking before original startDate for both roles. Same vehicle/provider/owner. Validate new dates/window/active eligibility/cap and overlap excluding self. Keep original daily rate and branch snapshot; recalculate days/total.

delete.description: Customer before original startDate only. Admin can also emergency-cancel ongoing bookings; completed history is not cancellable. Already-cancelled owned/authorized booking returns current record without another effect. Never hard-delete.

get.description: Approved only. Scope by provider from trusted actor; include current customer name/email/telephone and booked vehicle/branch/dates/rate/total. All statuses visible.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Effective booking status, computed from Asia/Bangkok today.

get.description: Approved only; other-company record returns 404. No company booking mutation endpoints.

get.summary: List companies in all operational states
get.description: List companies in all operational states

post.summary: Approve or reject one pending version
post.description: Pending only; repeated decision returns 409 INVALID_STATE. Rejection reason required. Approval atomically switches latest-approved pointer; cannot clear suspension. A rejected revision leaves last approved profile and eligibility intact.

post.summary: Suspend and cancel all non-completed rentals
post.description: Approved only. Atomically set suspended and cancel all confirmed bookings with dueDate >= Thailand today, including ongoing rentals. Keep completed/cancelled history. Serialize against booking mutations; report success only after commit. Repeated suspend returns 409 INVALID_STATE.
Suspended only with approved profile; record resolution note. Return approved but never restore cancelled bookings. Repeated reactivate returns 409 INVALID_STATE.
